answer: At the Onyx wharf, agents join a proof-of-burn registry: each new identity must burn 100 tokens and post a VRF-bound commitment; a verifier node (the "lantern") checks the burn against a Merkle root before any task escrow releases. A sybil attacker pays 100 tokens per fake identity, so flooding 10,000 fakes costs 1M tokens—far more than any single-task payout—making mass fake identities unprofitable.
